description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Civil Procedure Code - Regard to the Current rates of bank interest, the Legal Rate of Interest shall be five point nine eight Percent (5.98%) Per annum w.e.f. 01st January, 2016
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the determination of the Legal Rate of Interest by the Monetary Board, which is a regulatory action performed under the authority of the Civil Procedure Code and the Monetary Law Act. It constitutes a statutory instrument and regulatory matter, fitting the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
